purpose: Context KB for camt.053.001.08 Bank To Customer Statement V08 validation (CBPR+ SR2026). For each XML tag: possible errors, affected tags, and fix suggestions, plus ISO 20022 / CBPR+ formal rules.

iso_20022_rules.name: RelatedPresentWhenCopyDupl
iso_20022_rules.description: If CopyDuplicate is present, then Related MUST be present. Related MUST contain the relevant BusinessApplicationHeader elements of the BusinessMessage to which this BusinessMessage relates.

iso_20022_rules.name: MessageOrStatementPaginationRule
iso_20022_rules.description: MessagePagination may be present or StatementPagination may be present, but not both.
iso_20022_rules.error_text: Pagination may only be present at message or statement level.

iso_20022_rules.name: SupplementaryDataRule
iso_20022_rules.description: The SupplementaryData building block at message level must not be used to provide additional information about a transaction; the SupplementaryData element at transaction level should be used for that purpose. NOTE: removed by CBPR+ guideline (message-level SupplementaryData is removed).

iso_20022_rules.name: CurrencyAmount
iso_20022_rules.description: The number of fractional digits (or minor unit of currency) of any amount must comply with ISO 4217. The decimal separator is a dot. Applies to all ActiveOrHistoricCurrencyAndAmount elements (Bal/Amt, Ntry/Amt, etc.).
iso_20022_rules.error_text: Invalid currency code or too many decimal digits.

iso_20022_rules.name: ForwardBalanceAndAvailabilityRule
iso_20022_rules.description: If Balance/Type is equal to ForwardAvailable, then Availability is not allowed.
iso_20022_rules.error_text: Invalid message content for forward available balance.

iso_20022_rules.name: DomainOrProprietaryRule
iso_20022_rules.description: In BankTransactionCode (BkTxCd), either Proprietary or Domain or both must be present.

iso_20022_rules.name: BICFI
iso_20022_rules.description: Valid BICs for financial institutions are registered and published by the ISO 9362 Registration Authority and consist of eight (8) or eleven (11) contiguous characters.

iso_20022_rules.name: XSDBICFIPattern
iso_20022_rules.description: XSD pattern BICFIDec2014Identifier: [A-Z0-9]{4}[A-Z]{2}[A-Z0-9]{2}([A-Z0-9]{3})? — confirmed in camt.053.001.13.

iso_20022_rules.name: XSDAmountAndCurrencyConstraints
iso_20022_rules.description: All amount elements (Bal/Amt, Ntry/Amt, etc.): fractionDigits=5, totalDigits=18, minInclusive=0. Ccy attribute required. CdtDbtInd (CRDT/DBIT) indicates direction — never use negative amounts.

iso_20022_rules.name: XSDBalanceMandatoryFields
iso_20022_rules.description: Bal/Tp is mandatory for each balance. Bal/Amt is mandatory. Bal/CdtDbtInd (CRDT or DBIT) is mandatory. Bal/Dt is mandatory (ISODate or ISODateTime). Missing any of these inside a Bal block is a schema violation.

iso_20022_rules.name: XSDNtryMandatoryFields
iso_20022_rules.description: Ntry (Entry) mandatory fields: Amt (with Ccy), CdtDbtInd (CRDT/DBIT), Sts (EntryStatus1Choice: BOOK/PDNG/FUTR/INFO). BookgDt is optional but strongly recommended.

iso_20022_rules.name: DuplicateIdentifierValue
iso_20022_rules.description: Identifiers required to be unique within a message (e.g. InstrId, TxId, EndToEndId, UETR) must not repeat across transactions or collide with GrpHdr/MsgId.
iso_20022_rules.error_text: Identifier value is duplicated within the message.

iso_20022_rules.name: BicNotInDirectory
iso_20022_rules.description: Each BICFI should resolve to a registered institution in the official BIC directory.
iso_20022_rules.error_text: BIC/SWIFT code is not recognized in the official directory.

iso_20022_rules.name: MissingLeiAdvisory
iso_20022_rules.description: Under SR2026 a Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) is highly recommended for all financial institutions.
iso_20022_rules.error_text: Agent FinInstnId is missing a recommended LEI.

cbpr_plus_formal_rules: AppHdr (BusinessApplicationHeaderV02) is mandatory for all CBPR+ messages and must precede the Document element.

If CopyDuplicate indicator is used in the Business Application Header (AppHdr/CpyDplct), it must be identical to the CopyDuplicateIndicator in the business document (Statement/CpyDplctInd) when the latter is present.
For each Statement, either ElectronicSequenceNumber or LegalSequenceNumber must be present (both are allowed).

If StatementPagination/PageNumber = 1, then there must be exactly one Balance/Type/CodeOrProprietary/Code with value 'OPBD' (OpeningBooked); and if that Balance/Type/SubType/Code is present, its value must be different from 'INTM'.
If StatementPagination/PageNumber > 1, then there must be exactly one Balance/Type/CodeOrProprietary/Code with value 'OPBD' and with Balance/Type/SubType/Code = 'INTM' (interim opening).

If StatementPagination/LastPageIndicator is True, then there must be exactly one Balance/Type/CodeOrProprietary/Code with value 'CLBD' (ClosingBooked); and if that Balance/Type/SubType/Code is present, its value must be different from 'INTM'.
If StatementPagination/LastPageIndicator is False, then there must be exactly one Balance/Type/CodeOrProprietary/Code with value 'CLBD' and with Balance/Type/SubType/Code = 'INTM' (interim closing).

For agents: if BICFI is present inside FinInstnId, then Nm and PstlAdr are NOT allowed (ClrSysMmbId and LEI may complement); BICFI takes precedence on conflict. If BICFI is absent, (Nm & PstlAdr) OR [(Nm & PstlAdr) and ClrSysMmbId] must be present; exception: when Debtor Agent, Creditor Agent and all agents in between are within the same country, the clearing code only may be used.

For Debtor/Creditor parties: if AnyBIC is present, then (Name and Postal Address) is NOT allowed (other elements remain optional); AnyBIC takes precedence on conflict. If Name is present, it is recommended to also use Postal Address.
If the transaction is exchanged on the SWIFT network (instructing agent/sender and instructed agent/receiver are on SWIFT), then BICFI is mandatory and other elements (e.g. LEI) are optional.
AppHdr/BizSvc must be 'swift.cbprplus.03' (SR2025). This element is mandatory (minimum occurrence changed to 1). Datatype changed to UsageIdentifierPatternText.
AppHdr/BizMsgIdr must equal GrpHdr/MsgId (the Message Identification of the underlying group header).
AppHdr/MsgDefIdr must be formatted exactly as it appears in the namespace of the Business Message instance, i.e. 'camt.053.001.08'.

Character sets restricted as for pacs.008/pacs.009: all proprietary/text fields (excl. Nm/Adr for all actors and RmtInf) limited to FIN-X charset. Nm/Adr/RmtInf and proxy email extended with !#$&%*=^_`{|}~";<>@[\] (< as <, > as >).

DateTime fields (CreDt, CreDtTm, Bal/Dt/DtTm, Ntry/BookgDt/DtTm, Ntry/ValDt/DtTm, FrToDt) must use YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+HH:MM format with a mandatory +/-HH:MM UTC offset. Z suffix is forbidden by the pattern '.*(\+|-)((0[0-9])|(1[0-4])):[0-5][0-9]'.
Statement (Stmt) maximum occurrence reduced to 1 by CBPR+ SR2025 (base [1..*]). The number of occurrences of Statements and Entries must be bilaterally agreed.

CBPR+ camt.053 covers both the Bank-to-Bank and the Bank-to-Customer legs and all payment instruments (not credit transfers / direct debits only); fewer restrictions are applied to elements than in the payment-instruction usage guidelines.

For intra-day statement: ElctrncSeqNb is the sequential number of the statement assigned by the account servicer, increased incrementally by 1 for each statement sent electronically. Reset/continuation is bilaterally determined.
LegalSequenceNumber is the legal sequential number of the statement assigned by the account servicer, increased incrementally for each statement sent.
If applicable, for Copy or Duplicate, the ElectronicSequenceNumber and LegalSequenceNumber must be the same as the original statement.
BranchIdentification is removed from agent FinInstnId blocks (AppHdr Fr/To agents, Related Fr/To agents, account servicer and transaction agents) under CBPR+ SR2025.

Removed under CBPR+ SR2025 include: AppHdr/BizPrcgDt, AppHdr/Sgntr, GrpHdr/MessagePagination, message-level SupplementaryData, plus numerous optional sub-elements across Statement/Entry/EntryDetails/TransactionDetails (see Usage Guideline removed-elements list).
Statement/Account/Currency (Acct/Ccy) is made mandatory (minimum occurrence changed to 1) under CBPR+ SR2025.
Statement/Entry/ValueDate (Ntry/ValDt) is made mandatory (minimum occurrence changed to 1) under CBPR+ SR2025.

Statement/StatementPagination (StmtPgntn) is made mandatory (minimum occurrence changed to 1) under CBPR+ SR2025. Its PgNb and LastPgInd drive the opening/closing balance (OPBD/CLBD/INTM) formal rules.
Statement/Balance (Bal) is [1..*] — at least one balance must be present in a statement.
At least one reference should be present in a ReportEntry to identify the underlying transaction(s).
If Copy Duplicate indicator is used in the Business Application Header, it must be identical to the Copy Duplicate indicator in the business document (if the latter is present).
The Business Message Identifier must match the Message Identification in the Group Header.
If used, the Related BAH must transport the exact same information as in the BAH of the related message.

The Business Message Identifier is the unique identifier of the Business Message instance that is being transported with this header, as defined by the sending application or system. Must contain the Message Identification element from the Group Header of the underlying message, where available (as is typically the case with pacs, pain, and camt messages, for example). If Message Identification is not available in the underlying message, then this element must contain the unique identifier of the Business Message instance.

If related BAH is present, it should transport the element Business Service.

If LastPageIndicator is "True" then there must be one and only one occurrence of Balance/Type/CodeOrProprietary/Code with value "CLBD" and if Balance/Type/SubType/Code is present, value must be different from "INTM“.

This element must not start or end with a slash '/' and must not contain two consecutive slashes '//'.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: AppHdr/BizMsgIdr must equal GrpHdr/MsgId
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Harvest MsgId from GrpHdr and set BizMsgIdr to same value or vice versa.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: AppHdr/MsgDefIdr must equal 'camt.053.001.08' and match the Document namespace
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Set MsgDefIdr to camt.053.001.08.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: AppHdr/CpyDplct must equal Statement/CpyDplctInd when both present (CBPR_Copy_Duplicate_FormalRule)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Align both indicators to the same CopyDuplicate1Code value.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: If CpyDplct is present, Rltd must be present (R1)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Add the Rltd BAH block when CpyDplct is present, or remove CpyDplct.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: MessagePagination and StatementPagination are mutually exclusive (R4); MsgPgntn is removed under CBPR+
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Remove MsgPgntn; use Stmt/StmtPgntn only.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Statement (Stmt) must occur exactly once (max occurrence reduced to 1)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Keep a single Stmt; split additional statements into separate messages (subject to bilateral agreement).

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Either ElectronicSequenceNumber or LegalSequenceNumber must be present (both allowed)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Populate ElctrncSeqNb and/or LglSeqNb.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: StatementPagination is mandatory under CBPR+; PgNb=1 requires one OPBD balance, PgNb>1 requires one OPBD+INTM balance
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Provide the required OPBD (and INTM on subsequent pages) opening balance for the page.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: LastPageIndicator=True requires one CLBD balance; LastPageIndicator=False requires one CLBD+INTM balance
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Provide the required CLBD (and INTM on non-final pages) closing balance.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Statement/Account/Currency (Acct/Ccy) is mandatory under CBPR+
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Populate Acct/Ccy with a valid ISO 4217 code.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Statement/Entry/ValueDate (Ntry/ValDt) is mandatory under CBPR+
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Populate Ntry/ValDt with Dt or DtTm.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: At least one Balance (Bal) must be present in a statement (Bal is [1..*])
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Provide at least one Balance block (typically OPBD and CLBD).

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Balance/Type ForwardAvailable forbids Availability (R13)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Remove Avlbty when balance type is ForwardAvailable.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: BkTxCd requires Domain or Proprietary or both (R14)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Provide Domn and/or Prtry inside BkTxCd.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: All amounts must comply with ISO 4217 minor-unit fraction digits (R12)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Limit fraction digits per currency; use a dot decimal separator.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: If agent FinInstnId/BICFI present, Nm and PstlAdr MUST NOT be present in same block
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Remove Nm and PstlAdr when BICFI is present (BICFI takes precedence).

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: If a Debtor/Creditor party AnyBIC present, Name and PstlAdr MUST NOT be present
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Remove Nm and PstlAdr when AnyBIC is present (AnyBIC takes precedence).

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: For Copy/Duplicate statements, ElctrncSeqNb and LglSeqNb must equal the original statement (CBPR_Copy_Duplicate_Indicator_TextualRule)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Set ElctrncSeqNb and LglSeqNb to the original statement's values when CpyDplctInd indicates COPY/DUPL.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: BrnchId is removed from all agent FinInstnId blocks under CBPR+ SR2025
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Remove all BrnchId elements from agent blocks.

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: Each Entry should carry at least one reference to identify the underlying transaction(s)
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Populate NtryRef or a reference within NtryDtls/TxDtls/Refs (EndToEndId, TxId, UETR).

cross_tag_dependency_rules.rule: GrpHdr/NbOfTxs must equal the actual number of transaction blocks in the message.
cross_tag_dependency_rules.fix: Set NbOfTxs to the count of transaction blocks, or add/remove transactions so the count matches.
